retail.bytes_sha256_scope: 0x00512C30..0x005144DC hex-decoded from radare2 `p8 6317`, hashed independently; equals Binary Ninja's recorded function bytes digest.
retail.calling_convention: cdecl, no arguments. Binary Ninja renders __stdcall with 12 float/double arguments and radare2 reports 26 arguments; both are artifacts of the 0x14F0-byte frame allocated through 0x004A54A0 (MSVC __chkstk).

return.meaning: 0 after the normal drain path; the non-zero vertex-buffer Lock HRESULT when Lock(0x2020, &0x00A7F89C, 0) at 0x00512FDA fails (0x00512FE0 jne 0x005144D2). The HRESULTs of SetRenderState/SetTextureStageState/SetTransform/SetViewport are discarded and are NOT the return value; every such value is overwritten before the epilogue.

retail.callee_count_note: Binary Ninja reports 30 call sites; 20 of them are `rep movsd/stosd` pseudo-calls at 0x00C35040/0x00C35044. The 10 real sites are listed. Device methods are 20 indirect calls through the IDirect3DDevice7/IDirect3DVertexBuffer7 vtables: SetViewport (+0x34) once, SetTransform (+0x2C) once, SetRenderState (+0x50) 17 times, SetTextureStageState (+0x94) 10 times, SetTexture (+0x8C) 3 times per drain pass, DrawIndexedPrimitiveVB (+0x80) once per drawn chunk, Lock (+0xC) once, Unlock (+0x10) once.

four matrix-slab dwords set to -1 at +0x04
D3DVIEWPORT7: x, y, width, height, min_z, max_z
clipped-triangle counter consumed by the shared callee
heap-list base, index list, live count, element stride and slot offset used by the drain

structure: Prologue 0x00512C3A..0x00512DBC: fog depth ratio/offset, four -1 slab writes, viewport width/height, packed fog colour, identity matrix.
State set 0x00512DCD..0x00512FC2: SetTransform(state 1), SetViewport, 17 SetRenderState in retail order, 10 SetTextureStageState.
Lock 0x00512FD2..0x00512FE6: Lock(0x2020, &0x00A7F89C, 0); failure jumps to the epilogue with the HRESULT.

Block loop 0x0051305D..0x005143AD: g_b16c9c iterations over g_b12c60; each block: origin copy, null guard, vertex/LOD counts, view-distance cull, projection loops, strip/backface command pass, blend passes, fourth section.
Flush 0x005143B5..0x0051445B: Unlock, then three blend-mode scans of the visible-chunk list (Terrain_UnknownBlendmode, SetTexture, DrawIndexedPrimitiveVB).
Drain 0x0051445D..0x005144D0: pop/remap/remove every remaining visible chunk with HeapList_Remove; return 0 at 0x005144D2.

loops.note: Counted from radare2 `pdf` backward branches; the 0x0051308B block-loop back-edge at 0x005143AD is the outer loop. Binary Ninja/radare2 report 144 blocks / 215 edges.

divergences.summary: Retail dereferences the block pointer before its null test; the candidate tests null first.
divergences.retail: 0x005130A7..0x005130B0 copies six dwords from [block+0] with rep movsd, then 0x005130DD lea ebp,[eax+0x18], then 0x005130E0 je 0x0051438A on a null block pointer. A null block faults in retail.
divergences.candidate: terrain_draw.cpp:589 tests `block == nullptr` and `continue`s before any read.
divergences.impact: Only the null-block input differs: retail faults, the candidate skips the block. Non-null paths are unchanged.
divergences.resolution: Recorded, not changed; matching a fault is not desirable and no retail observation of a null block exists.

divergences.summary: The device and vertex buffer are host mirrors; missing mirrors throw std::logic_error instead of dereferencing null.
divergences.retail: 0x005CA114 and 0x00A7F890 are raw retail globals; a null value faults at the first vtable call.
divergences.candidate: require_device()/require_vertex_buffer() throw; Terrain_HostInstallRenderDevice installs the pointers.
divergences.impact: The failure mode is a C++ exception instead of an access violation; the success path calls the same vtable slots with the same arguments.

divergences.summary: Viewport dimensions come from host getters instead of the retail display-mode object.
divergences.retail: 0x00491CF0 returns 0x00C28B40 twice; +4 width, +8 height are stored into 0x00A7F860.
divergences.impact: Equal only when the host display state mirrors the retail display mode; not runtime-compared.

divergences.summary: x87 80-bit arithmetic and transcendental instructions are modelled with long double and libm.
divergences.retail: F2XM1/FSCALE-based exp2, FISTP qword conversions, x87 control word from the caller.
divergences.impact: Last-bit differences can change fog thresholds (0.01/0.99), ramp integers, and cull/clip boundary decisions. Not runtime-compared; no rounding-mode capture exists.
divergences.resolution: Documented as a semantic coverage limit, not a structural mismatch.

divergences.summary: Candidate local arrays and the tail of the 0x40-byte special record are zero-initialised; retail reuses uninitialised stack slots.
divergences.retail: Frame slots hold previous-block/previous-call garbage except where written on the live path.
divergences.candidate: Aggregate initialisation zeros vertices/flags/ramp and the record tail.
divergences.impact: No difference on the live path when all indexed entries were written first; a malformed command referencing an unwritten entry would differ.

divergences.summary: Frame, helper outlining and exception machinery differ.
divergences.retail: 0x14F0-byte frame via 0x004A54A0; Unlock/drain inline; no unwind tables.
divergences.candidate: 0x1614-byte frame via __chkstk_ms, ebp frame, anonymous-namespace flush_and_release() outlined (793 bytes), SJLJ unwind frame and ud2 resume path.
divergences.impact: No live-path semantic difference; machine shape and call graph differ.

divergences.candidate: 126 blocks / 183 edges / 2629 instructions / 46 backward branches, plus a 26/39/198 helper; libm inlining and EH cold edges inflate the counts.

limitations: Status is STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED: the 17 compared properties and control-flow-relevant quantities match the retail disassembly, but the candidate machine CFG is not isomorphic and no semantic bit-exactness is claimed.
Static comparison only: no runtime capture, no IGI-Probe/Frida observation, no rendered terrain comparison and no memory-state comparison. BUILD_VERIFIED, RUNTIME_TESTED and VERIFIED are not claimed.
No compiled test or behavioral runner exists for this native; the gate's --allow-structural-only path is used, which cannot detect wrong calculations.

The candidate was measured as the pre-link COFF object; the same bytes are linked in build-clean-win32/igi1.exe at 0x00452980 with a 0x3180 extent. The executable also contains other agents' current sources and is not evidence of full-game behaviour.

The candidate object is 12664 bytes of code / 2629 instructions versus retail 6317 / 1670 because GCC emits long-double libm calls and SJLJ exception paths; code size, block counts and back-edge counts are not comparable across compilers.
x87 80-bit intermediates and FISTP are modelled with long double and libm; exp2l/llrintl/nearbyintl were not proved to match every inherited x87/MXCSR rounding mode (TD-D4).
Retail dereferences a null block pointer before its null test; the candidate skips null blocks (TD-D1).
The host device/vertex-buffer mirrors and throwing guards are candidate-only failure semantics (TD-D2, TD-D3).
Local arrays and the 0x40-byte record tail are zero-initialised where retail uses stack garbage (TD-D5).
The 0x14F0 frame is not reproduced; GCC uses 0x1614 bytes, an ebp frame, __chkstk_ms and an SJLJ unwind frame (TD-D6).
Terrain_BuildMipMaps_2, Terrain_OutOfTerrainRenderch, Terrain_UnknownBlendmode and HeapList_Remove are separate natives; their behaviour and status are outside this comparison (TD-D8).
The source comment's instruction-level coverage claim is the source's; this comparison verifies the listed structural properties, not a line-by-line audit of all 1670 retail instructions.
cfg_similarity 1.0 is the retail Binary Ninja-vs-radare2 score only. No candidate-vs-retail CFG score is asserted.
The 'final SetRenderState HRESULT' wording in the task is not supported: all state-set HRESULTs are discarded; only the Lock HRESULT escapes, and only on failure.

status_recommendation.rationale: Function identity, ABI, extent, call/state order, block-loop bounds, culling, projection loops, strip/backface logic, blend/fourth-pass iteration, chunk emission, submission order, drain and both return paths match the retail disassembly; 16 of the 17 compared properties match and the floating-point modelling property is explicitly partial (TD-D4). The remaining differences are documented implementation-shape, host-abstraction and floating-point-modeling items, not observed control-flow or ordering mismatches.
remaining: No semantic-review report was bound before this comparison; the accompanying semantic review is bound to the same source digest.
No runtime, rendered, culling or memory observation exists.
The candidate machine CFG is not isomorphic; no candidate-vs-retail CFG score is claimed.
